## Summary

Krishal Karna is a backend and applied ML engineer based in Bangalore, India.
He is a final-year Computer Science & Engineering student at Jain
(Deemed-to-be) University, Bangalore, graduating in June 2027, with a CGPA of
9.5/10 (top 1% of batch) and an EdCIL COMPEX Scholarship, a Government of
India merit award covering full tuition. He builds Django and Django REST
Framework backends, scikit-learn ML pipelines, LangGraph LLM systems, and n8n
automations, along with the Next.js frontends that make them usable. His
flagship project, DataLens AI, is a full-stack data quality platform combining
automated CSV profiling, three scikit-learn models, and a LangGraph + Gemini
layer that explains data quality issues in plain language. He previously
interned as a Full Stack Developer at Mahalaxmi Tech Group Pvt. Ltd., building
Next.js pages wired to Django REST APIs. He has solved 250+ data structures
and algorithms problems on LeetCode and writes a technical SQL series on
Hashnode. He is open to backend engineering, applied ML, and AI engineering
roles for the 2027 graduating batch.

## Experience

- Full Stack Developer Intern — Mahalaxmi Tech Group Pvt. Ltd. (Remote) — Jan 2026 – Mar 2026 — Built Next.js pages and reusable UI components wired to Django REST APIs, in a PR-based GitHub workflow with code review.
- Technical Team Lead — Enigma Club, Jain University — Oct 2025 – Apr 2026 — Led the technical team across club events, hosted Innovation Duel 2025, and organized AI/ML and web development workshops.

## Projects

- DataLens AI — Full-stack data quality platform: CSV profiling, an Isolation Forest / KNN imputation / TF-IDF similarity ML pipeline, and a LangGraph + Gemini layer explaining root causes. — Django REST, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, scikit-learn, LangGraph, Gemini, Docker, AWS EC2 — https://dataquality-ai.vercel.app/ — https://github.com/kreeshal17/Datalens-AI
- Luma AI Studio — AI coding agent that generates and incrementally edits React components via a LangGraph + Gemini tool-calling loop with persistent multi-turn sessions. — Next.js, FastAPI, LangGraph, Gemini, PostgreSQL — https://codewithluma.vercel.app/ — https://github.com/kreeshal17/LUMA-AI-STUDIO
- BookMandu — Multi-vendor book marketplace with a delivery-gated review system: only verified buyers who actually received the book can review it. — Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Tailwind, Vercel AI SDK — https://bookmandu.vercel.app/ — https://github.com/kreeshal17/bookbazaar
- Production-Grade Retail SQL Analytics — Analyzed 1M+ retail sales records with CTEs, window functions, and A/B testing, surfacing a statistically significant 6–9% sales uplift. — SQL, Statistics, A/B Testing, CTEs — https://github.com/kreeshal17/production-grade-sql-analytics
- Jeevan Mitra — AI-powered wellness platform with real-time voice consultations, health tracking, and anonymous peer support chat. — Next.js, Firebase, Vapi SDK, Gemini — https://jeevan-mitra.vercel.app/ — https://github.com/kreeshal17/jeevan-mitra
- AI-Powered CSV Analysis Agent — Conversational analytics over any CSV with dynamic schema inference and real-time chart generation. — FastAPI, Streamlit, Python — https://analysis-csv.streamlit.app/ — https://github.com/kreeshal17/CSV-Analysis-Agent
- IPL Analytics Power BI Dashboard — End-to-end Power BI analytics on IPL match data (2008–2025) with dynamic DAX calculations. — Power BI, DAX, Data Viz — https://github.com/kreeshal17/ipl-analytics-powerbi
- Customer Segmentation using RFM + K-Means — K-Means clustering on RFM metrics with an interactive Power BI dashboard. — Python, K-Means, RFM, Power BI — https://github.com/kreeshal17/E-commerce-Customer-Order-Data-for-Clusterin
- Anime Recommendation Engine — Genre-based K-Means clustering for anime similarity recommendations via a Flask REST API. — Python, K-Means, Flask — https://github.com/kreeshal17/Anime-recommendation
- News Veracity Pipeline Advanced — Hybrid fake news detection combining TF-IDF ensemble models with evidence-aware web verification. — Flask, React, TF-IDF, NLP — https://github.com/kreeshal17/news-veracity-pipeline-advanced
- Text Summarization App — Full-stack NLP app summarizing documents using TextRank, TF-IDF, and PageRank. — Flask, React, TextRank, NLP — https://github.com/kreeshal17/text-summarization-app
- Smart Rental Tracking System — QR-based asset check-in/out with demand forecasting and anomaly detection, built for the Caterpillar hackathon. — Bun, Hono, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Next.js
- Events Platform Backend — Backend service for an events platform. — https://github.com/kreeshal17/event-platform-Backend-
